<!-- verdify-paused-handoff-20261012:245 -->
Jason's shutdown handoff: **implementation and delivery PAUSED; do not auto-resume.**

**Current state:** OPEN and PAUSED; no later acceptance receipt was established by this shutdown capture. The October11 clause assessment remains the prior boundary; any dated runtime/telemetry facts in it require refresh on resume.

**Prior clause assessment (October11, not a new runtime probe):** Production remains verdify-db-0. All three rehearsal clusters are healthy but at migration 270, four behind production. Complete parity, writer fencing, cutover packet and post-cutover bake are unproved. S2 does not authorize a cutover.

**Blockers:** Jason explicitly paused all implementation/delivery. Native blocking dependencies: VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#396, VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#382. The listed acceptance boundary remains unproved beyond linked historical receipts.

**Next step on explicit resume:** After explicit Jason resume, refresh exact source/live and predecessor evidence, then satisfy: A rehearsal proves all writers are quiescent and measures downtime, parity, RPO/RTO and both rollback boundaries.

**Acceptance retained:**
- [ ] A rehearsal proves all writers are quiescent and measures downtime, parity, RPO/RTO and both rollback boundaries.
- [ ] Production source/running DB authority and health are verified through at least the declared 60-minute initial observation and seven-day durability bake.
- [ ] No old database/PVC removal before separate verified retention/decommission criteria; no unqualified sub-minute zero-loss promise.
